Enrollment is announced as enrolling soon; ask about the next dose group before arranging care. Splenic hemangiosarcoma must be confirmed by pathology before joining, but owners awaiting results or with splenectomy scheduled may inquire now. The first dose must be possible within 21 days after splenectomy. No previous chemotherapy, radiation or other investigational drug; no intended breeding. Regular Urbana visits are required. This initial study establishes dose and side effects; improved survival and reduced heart toxicity are not established. Permanent infertility is expected in intact male dogs.
